2026-10-08-feed.title: The feed is here
2026-10-08-feed.body: Share your day on the Free board and today's completed routines on the Proof board. Proof posts carry a badge with the routine you completed, and "Mine" gathers just your own posts.

2026-10-08-market.title: Furniture market
2026-10-08-market.body: Buy and sell furniture with other members in the Market tab of Decorate. You can even list furniture you made from a photo. Report posts or furniture that bother you, and block members you don't want to see.

2026-10-08-games.title: Mini-games, bigger and clearer
2026-10-08-games.body: Play Routine Runner big by turning your phone sideways, and Cat Merge now shows the time left. Tiles from 128 up each get their own color.

2026-10-08-routines.title: Calendar and routine tweaks
2026-10-08-routines.body: The weekly calendar now shows all 7 days of a week that spans two months. You can unlink a routine or category from its house mission yourself.

2026-09-13-minigames.title: Three mini-games in your room
2026-09-13-minigames.body: Routine Runner, Cat Stairs, and Merge Cats. Pick one from the game button in your room and climb the global ranking.

2026-09-13-auto-attendance.title: Automatic attendance, holidays on the calendar
2026-09-13-auto-attendance.body: Completing your first routine of the day checks you in automatically. Public holidays show in red on the calendar.

2026-09-11-web-app.title: Rougether on desktop and in the browser
2026-09-11-web-app.body: Log in with the same account and your room and routines are right there. Handy for organizing to-dos on a computer.
